title: Almost Affine Vector Rank-Metric Codes
summary: We define almost affine vector rank-metric codes as subsets $\mathcal{C}\subseteq \mathbb{F}_{q^m}^n$ whose canonical projections have cardinalities that are powers of $q^m$, and prove that they naturally induce $q$-matroids. We establish that the operations of puncturing and shortening correspond to restriction and contraction of the $q$-matroid, and show that the rank-weight and formal dual distance distributions are determined by the induced $q$-matroid.
